mainEntity.name: What US-specific issues should I think about before using AI in my small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: A US-based owner should treat privacy, marketing, intellectual-property, accessibility, and platform requirements as practical operating considerations rather than assuming AI makes them disappear. The applicable details depend on the data, audience, channel, and state involved, so avoid copying a generic compliance checklist. Small-business guidance highlights privacy, security, intellectual-property, customer-trust, and human-review concerns. Run My AI Biz’s materials can help explain workflow structure, but they are not a substitute for reviewing requirements relevant to your business. Keep records of sources, approvals, permissions, and customer-facing disclosures where appropriate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider privacy, security, marketing-channel rules, intellectual-property concerns, accessibility, platform terms, and any state requirements relevant to your data and audience. Keep source and approval records, and obtain specialized advice when the facts require it.
